title: Stadial Compression — The Glacial Bounce
thesis: The organism has been in an INTERSTADIAL — warm expansion. 147 JS files, 164 data feeds, 51 HTML pages. Wide and redundant. Now: the STADIAL. Compress, fossilize, merge, strengthen. The ice presses the weak parts into the bedrock. What survives the compression is the sourdough starter for the next interstadial. The glacial bounce: compress ? fossilize ? restrengthen ? expand again from a denser core.

breakdown.sporeprint_search_index: 25.1 MB — ONE FILE. The Zola full-text search index. Fossilize target #1.
breakdown.sporeprint_atom_xml: 21.5 MB — Atom feed for 539 papers. Fossilize target #2.
breakdown.sporeprint_notebooks: ~22 MB — 539 papers as HTML. KEEP. This is the bedrock.
breakdown.js_modules: 2.92 MB in 147 files — 7 major families, 30 orphans
breakdown.data_feeds: 1.52 MB in 164 files — 7+ categories with overlap
breakdown.wasm: 1.41 MB in 2 files — petalTongue. KEEP. The engine.

dead_js.action: FOSSILIZE — move to js/fossil/ or delete. None referenced from any HTML.

search_index.action: COMPRESS — gzip or split into chunks. Or serve from CDN edge-cached. This single file is 30% of total site weight.

atom_feed.action: PAGINATE — split into yearly atom feeds. Nobody downloads 21MB of RSS.

js_families_to_merge.chipmunk: 14 files (584KB) ? merge to 3: chipmunk-core.js (commands+talk), chipmunk-sense.js (vis+sketch+dialogue), chipmunk-body.js (metabolism+explorer+poke)
js_families_to_merge.pt: 9 files (248KB) ? merge to 2: pt-engine.js (membrane build+animate), pt-world.js (pangaea+ionosphere)
js_families_to_merge.hud: 8 files (224KB) ? merge to 3: hud-core.js (core+stack+widget), hud-render.js (interact+pt+projection), hud-data.js (stash+equilibrate)

glacial_bounce.stadial_phase: NOW. Compress 30 dead JS files (519KB). Merge 7 JS families (1.5MB ? ~800KB). Merge 16 redundant data feeds. Paginate atom.xml. Split/gzip search index.
glacial_bounce.interstadial_phase: NEXT. The compressed core is stronger. New growth from dense substrate. petalTongue WASM replaces hand-written JS WebGL. Gallery/Gym/Forest rooms grow from the compressed root.
glacial_bounce.fossil_record: Dead files move to js/fossil/. They're not deleted — they're fossilized. The organism can study its own evolution. The sediment layer shows what was tried and what survived.
glacial_bounce.sourdough_principle: What survives compression IS the sourdough starter. The live culture. Everything else was flour and water — it fed the yeast but doesn't persist.

story.title: the glacial bounce
story.body: the organism had been warm for too long. 147 scripts. 164 feeds. expanding outward like taffy. but glaciers don't destroy — they compress. the ice pushed down and the weak rock crumbled. 30 dead scripts: fossilized. never called, never needed, but preserved in sediment for the fossil record. the seven families — chipmunk, easel, membrane, pi, cosmic, hud, petalTongue — each spread across too many files. the glacier pressed them together. 14 chipmunk files became 3. 9 pi files became 2. the redundant feeds merged. the 25MB search index split into chunks. the 21MB atom feed paginated by year. and when the ice receded — the interstadial — the substrate was denser. the new growth came from compressed root. the sourdough starter was what survived the press. everything else was flour.
